title: Among users who joined in 2010 and have posted content tagged with 'humor',
question: Among users who joined in 2010 and have posted content tagged with 'humor', find the percentage of their posts that received more than 50 favorites. Return the user display name and this percentage.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055" AS display_name,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p."XCL_039" > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p."XCL_026") AS percentage
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
JOIN tags t ON t."XCL_050" = p."XCL_026" AND t."XCL_048" = 'humor'
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', u."XCL_054") = '2010'
GROUP BY u."XCL_052", u."XCL_055"
